findings.text: Ask 4 is not done: `git diff --cached --name-only` still lists the same 212 stray files saved in `stray-staged-before.txt`. Run `git restore --staged --pathspec-from-file=stray-staged-before.txt` (unstages only) and record that it ran.

The diff includes an unrequested change: `Server/Worktrees.mjs` `merged_stale`, its test, `Server/worktree-servers.mjs` and `Server/doc/worktree-servers.md`. It has nothing to do with merge staging, so it belongs in its own task (or the task folder must say why it rode along).

`Server/merge.mjs:~644` still prints `overlap.length ? overlap.join(", ") : "staged files"` in the three-way branch, but the `else` is now reached only when `overlap` is non-empty. Drop the dead "staged files" fallback.

`commitLanded`'s final `git reset -q HEAD -- <landed paths>` (merge.mjs ~line 141) would silently drop another agent's staged edit if it sat on a path this merge lands. That is a narrow overlap and the files are dirty-checked first, but it is not covered by a test.
The new tests (strays untouched, deletion, refused conflict leaves index/HEAD/MERGE_HEAD/temp index clean) match ask 3 well; no test runs a failed `commitLanded` (the "NOT COMMITTED" path, exit 1).

Docs: `Server/doc/review.md` and `commit-rule.md` were updated as asked, and the file header comment matches the new behaviour. A fresh agent can continue from the task folder (requirements, past-work, stray list), but nothing records that asks 1 and 4 (the reproduction and the index clean) were actually carried out.

log: agent-mastermind-merge-staged: reproduced the loop on scratch repos in merge.test.mjs (prior staged strays + a landing: old code left its own paths staged, new code leaves the index exactly as found). Root cause: threeWay() skipped its commit when anything was staged and ran git add -A on its landed paths.

review answer 1 (fix): done. 212 stray staged paths (all .jsonl/index.json records) unstaged with git restore --staged --pathspec-from-file=stray-staged-before.txt; git diff --cached is now empty; working files untouched.

review answer 2 (fix): worktree-servers --stop-stale (Worktrees.merged_stale, test, doc) rode along on purpose: vscode-mastermind asked for it as a second item in this same merge (both are Server/ worktree tooling; a fresh 0-commit branch was read as merged and replay-bubbles' server was stopped).
review answer 3 (fix): already gone in the committed merge.mjs; the overlap branch prints overlap.join only.

review answer 4 (note): a staged edit on a path this merge lands is, by the dirty check, an overlap: it is three-way merged and its content is committed with the landing, then the path is reset to HEAD. Nothing is lost (the working file holds it), only the staged flag. Left untested: narrow, and the alternative (refuse) is the loop this task removes.
review answer 5 (note): a failed commitLanded prints NOT COMMITTED, exits 1, leaves files written and unstaged. Not forced in a test (needs a git failure injected); the path is two lines.
answer to clarity-merge-staged: thanks, the proposal was clear; no rewrite needed.
